variants.title: Standing Orders
variants.premise: The guard stands at the berth, arms crossed, watching the gangplank.

lines.speaker: P
lines.text: Any chance of a ship out of here?

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Not without leave. Orders from the top.

lines.speaker: P
lines.text: Whose orders exactly?

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: My captain's. He won't vouch for you.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Not me. I just stand here.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Fair enough.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Go on, try it.

lines.speaker: X
lines.text: He doesn't budge.

variants.title: Nobody's Business
variants.premise: The guard eyes a rowdy crowd outside the Flaming Arrow, half-listening.

lines.speaker: P
lines.text: I need a boat off Varlamore.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: So does half this dock, iknami.

lines.speaker: P
lines.text: So what's stopping me?

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: No captain'll take an unproven stranger.

lines.speaker: X
lines.text: The guard watches the pub.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Don't ask me. Nobody tells me either.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Try that and see what happens.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: That's your business, not mine.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: I don't get paid to be charming.

variants.title: Proof at Last
variants.premise: The guard clocks the quiver on the player's back and straightens up.

lines.speaker: P
lines.text: I'm back. Which ship can I take?

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: That's Dizana's quiver on your back.

lines.speaker: X
lines.text: The guard looks you over, then nods.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Talk to the registrar. Inside, past the ledger desk.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Dock building behind me. Ledger desk.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Timoiva. Go on, then.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Fair enough. You got here.
